name: How much should I budget for unexpected issues?

mainEntity.name: How much should I budget for unexpected issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: A contingency reserve of about 10% to 20% of the project cost is a practical starting point. That buffer can help cover hidden repairs, code-related upgrades, or material substitutions without stalling the project. If your home is older, the safer end of that range is usually more realistic.
